jana: quick weirdness while onboarding magnet-30b-v2-int4: longprefill stitched run produced a cluster of "anchor" tokens around 19k, but only when sampling temperature <= 0.7. at temp=1.0 it's noisy but no anchor collapse. anyone seen temperature interacting with kv/stitch?

omar: interesting. sampling temp + quant noise could lower entropy and make logits stick to anchors when phase jitter occurs. what flags?

jana: `--prefill_mode=stream --stitch=true --prefill_stride=1024 --kv_index_type=relative --quant=int4 --temp=0.6`

maya: can you attach a short failing tail? also run `KVCACHE_DEBUG=1` to show index/phase at boundary.

jana: pasted tail + tiny debug snippet:
```
...the quick brown fox jumps the anchor-12 anchor-12 the the
[19188] kv: rel->abs 19188 -> 19188
[19188] rotary_phase: 0.9998 -> 0.00014 (wrap)
[19189] sample_temp=0.6 logits_peak=11.2 -> softmax sharp, token='anchor-12'
```

prateek: that log screams phase wrap right at the stitch point. low temp makes sampling pick the highest-likelihood token; small quant/phase shifts are amplified. try temp=0.9 and quant_fallback=int8 to see which axis reduces it.

alon: also check whether stitch interpolation re-normalizes rotary using compiler default base=10000 instead of model base. a small base mismatch + low temp will bias argmax.

omar: quick experiment matrix I'd run: (A) temp sweep 0.4->1.2 (B) stitch=false (C) rotary_base_override=65536 (D) quant_fallback=int8. run small batches to 20k.

jana: kicked off A/B/C/D. CI job id 1805123457 queued. ci-bot: nightly_pipeline/run/1805123457 queued :eyes:

ci-bot: artifacts -> s3://redwood-ci/runs/1805123457/

maya: if (B) clean, it isolates stitch merge; if (C) fixes, it's rotary base mismatch. if only (D) fixes, it's quant jitter interacting with low temp sampling. likely combo.

prateek: small mitigation: in stitch merge, clamp phase delta to small epsilon and add a tiny temperature bump when phase_delta>threshold (e.g., temp *= 1.1) as a stopgap. we'll need a proper fix though.

jana: initial results: (A) temp>=0.85 reduces anchors; (B) stitch=false clean; (C) rotary_override=65536 partially reduces but not full; (D) int8 clean. seems like int4 jitter + stitch phase discontinuity + low temp -> anchor saturation.

alon: actionable: 1) add stitch boundary assert logging phase delta and effective temp in generated traces; 2) add unit test that replays KVCACHE_DEBUG and runs sampling at different temps to detect anchor collapse; 3) add model-load check for rotary_base mismatch and warn.

omar: i'll open a small PR with the stitch clamp + logging and a reproducer that simulates low-temp sampling on cached logits. cc @prateek.

prateek: will also add an int4 calibration check for per-layer scale variance at stitch points; if variance > eps we fallback to int8 on that merge. cheap but practical.

jana: thanks — uploading full outputs and debug traces to ML ticket ML-4802. sample failing tail: "...jumps the anchor-12 anchor-12 the the"

maya: nice repro, ping when PRs land and we'll run a week-long stability burn. :thumbsup:
